_instructions: Add blog posts here. Each post needs: id, title, date, summary, file.
Create the .md file in content/blog/ with the post content.
Bilingual posts: in the .md file put the Italian text after a line '<!-- lang:it -->' and the English text after a line '<!-- lang:en -->'.
Optional 'i18n' object localizes title/summary on the blog page; plain 'title'/'summary' are the fallback (and are used on the home page).

posts.title: Welcome to my blog
posts.summary: First post on this blog. Stay tuned for updates on my research activities.
